method: Local fixtures only. Both CLIs run with backgrounds on and smart shrinking left at the CLI default (on). wkhtmltopdf is passed --enable-local-file-access. The report fixture adds a table of contents and a header/footer of [page]/[topage] and [doctitle], which both tools can paint with their native header path. Cold: one process per document. Warm: one printkit.Converter per fixture, pool size 1, timed around Converter.PDF after the browser is already up. Throughput: N processes, or one Converter with pool size N. CPU for a finished process is the greater of wait4 rusage and the high-water mark of user+sys ticks summed over the live process tree. rusage alone misses Chromium children that are not reaped into the parent. The live sum alone misses a few ticks that land in the parent as it exits, which is the whole cost of a short wkhtmltopdf run. Warm CPU is a delta of the live sum on the harness and includes a light RSS sampler. RSS sums VmRSS every 15ms and counts shared pages once per process. PSS sums smaps_rollup about every 120ms. Percentiles are nearest-rank, rank = ceil(p*n)-1. Daemon: htmlprint serve on a unix socket with pool size 1; wall time is the client and RSS/PSS are the server process tree. FindChrome may select chrome-headless-shell.
